## Create Versatile Updos at Home

Wear your hair up in a range of fashionable styles with the Bundle Monster 9-in-1 Fashion Hair Design Styling Tools Accessories Kit. Its nine tools help you shape buns, braids, and twists, so you can change your look for work, weekends, or special occasions.

## Everything You Need in One Set

This kit includes a bun maker, bun roller, braid twist tool, spiral bun holders, elastics, and pins. You get the supplies to try different styles without buying each item separately. Choose black, brown, or blonde to match your hair color closely, so the tools blend in with your hair.

## Built for Beginners

New to updos? Basic instructions come in the packaging to help you get started. Practice a few styles and build your skills at your own pace.

## Value for Your Hair Routine

As a complete set, this kit gives you a practical way to stock your hair styling essentials and experiment with new looks.

**Add the Bundle Monster kit to your cart and start creating your next updo.**
